title: sync-me
description:
sync-me is a Claude Code skill that runs an interactive, grill-style teaching session for a person working with a coding agent. It maps the likely uncertainty branches, anticipates the difficulty points and checks recall per branch, in three modes: unstick, catch-up and walk.

This release (1.0.0)

First standalone release. Three modes, a notes location that is asked once per repo, a walk-mode runbook linter and a smoke test suite.

Roadmap at 1.0.0

Now: measured round trips per walk step. Next: a recorded benchmark for unstick and catch-up. Later: none planned.
